reproduction_target: Computational telomere-to-telomere genome assembly of two Rubus genomes (XMM = Rubus hirsutus 'Penglei'; DHP = Rubus eustephanos 'Dahongpao') from ONT + PacBio HiFi + Illumina reads, Hi-C chromosome-scale scaffolding, assembly QC (BUSCO completeness, LTR Assembly Index), repeat/TE annotation, structural gene annotation, comparative genomics (synteny, structural variation, PAV), gene-family expansion/contraction with divergence-time estimation, and RNA-seq differential expression to identify sugar-accumulation candidate genes (MFS1, RhSTP13, RhSTP7).
granularity_note: STAGE-1 PROSE-ONLY. The main-text METHODS section is a single-sentence pointer: 'Comprehensive detailed procedures are provided in the Supplementary Information.' The tool-and-version-level Methods therefore live entirely in the un-retrievable Supplementary Information (a separate media download not present in the bioRxiv full-text HTML or JATS). Full text obtained via bioRxiv v2 full HTML (biorxiv source.xml was Cloudflare-1015 rate-limited and, for the non-versioned path, returned a mismatched DOI 2025.05.24.655935; abstract cross-checked via Europe PMC PPR1002603). The 9 coarse C-layer steps below are inferred from the Results narrative plus supplementary figure captions that name pipeline stages (Fig S3 'Assembly pipeline for Rubus genome'; Fig S5 'Pipeline of genome annotation'; Fig S12 'data sources, tools, and module interactions of RubusDB'). Almost no tool is named in retrievable prose (only BUSCO and LTR Assembly Index/LAI appear, as result metrics); NO tool version appears anywhere; there is NO Code Availability statement and no code repository; the Data Availability statement names the National Genomics Data Center (NGDC) but provides NO accession number, so raw reads/assemblies are not resolvable. Wet-lab steps (sequencing library prep + sequencing, Sanger validation of inversions, transient expression assay, sugar/phenotype measurement) counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Telomere-to-telomere (gap-free) de novo genome assembly of XMM and DHP from ONT + PacBio HiFi + Illumina reads — assembler not named in retrievable prose (Supplementary Fig S3 pipeline)
Hi-C chromosome-scale scaffolding / interaction-heatmap construction — tool not named in retrievable prose
Assembly completeness QC — BUSCO (99.18% XMM / 99.23% DHP); named as a metric only, no version, no lineage/parameters in retrievable prose
Assembly continuity QC — LTR Assembly Index (LAI); named as a metric only, no tool/version (LTR_retriever implied but not stated)
Repeat / transposable-element annotation of the two assemblies — tool not named in retrievable prose
Structural gene annotation (28,204 genes XMM / 28,569 genes DHP) — pipeline not named in retrievable prose (Supplementary Fig S5)

Comparative genomics: synteny, interspecific structural variation (translocations, inversions, segmental duplications) and presence/absence variation (PAV) detection — tools not named in retrievable prose
Gene-family expansion/contraction analysis and divergence-time estimation (~3.21 Mya) — tools (CAFE-class / dating) not named in retrievable prose
RNA-seq / transcriptome differential-expression analysis to identify sugar-accumulation candidate genes (RhSTP13, RhSTP7, MFS1) — tools not named in retrievable prose

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: All 9 computational steps cap at NI. None can reach RI: the tool-level Methods reside entirely in un-retrievable Supplementary Information, no tool version appears anywhere in retrievable prose, there is no Code Availability statement and no code repository, and the raw reads/assemblies are 'archived at the National Genomics Data Center' with NO accession number, so inputs are not resolvable. The only tools named in retrievable prose (BUSCO, LTR Assembly Index) appear as result metrics without versions. capture_claim = none; not a stage2 candidate.
